folder.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: ONE production folder icon for Backleaf, a calm modern desktop file manager. Design a beautifully simple front-facing file folder with a broad gently rounded body and ONE small softly raised rounded tab at upper left. Silhouette must be friendly, smooth and continuous: generous corner curves, a gradual curved transition into the tab instead of sharp beveled steps. Muted light powder-blue / blue-gray body, a slightly lighter rear lip, restrained soft material depth, no harsh dark outline. Clean nearly-flat product icon rendering, macOS quality with contemporary calm UI restraint. Broad simple planes, one subtle tonal edge only, recognizable at 18px sidebar size and 44px file-grid size. Shape approximately 5:4 width-to-height, centered on square canvas with 15% breathing room. Absolutely genuine transparent background with alpha. The complete folder is visible: clean fully opaque interior, crisp antialiased exterior, no white fringe, white blocks, clipped sides, holes, erased edges, stray pixels or background-removal artifacts. No separate rounded-square tile or container. No papers peeking out, no symbols, words, letters, logo, badge, long shadow, ground, backdrop, glow, gloss, heavy gradient, grain, metallic bevel or isometric perspective. One finished icon only.

Exactly one icon, same artwork; genuine alpha outside.
